editorialReview: Direct Japanese-only packet translated to Indonesian, using own-locale definitions only for exact Japanese matches; no pivot or other-locale input.

Read each translation in its whole paragraph/question context, preserving actors, recipients, conditions, uncertainty, negation, sequence, adult register and limits; no source clinical procedure invented.
Preserved lifestyle support versus infection-prevention guarantees, REM/non-REM nuance, aging individual differences and atypical/multiple illness observations.
Explicit individual fluid restriction/swallowing plans and medical assessment retained; no universal fluid amount, invented measurements or thirst-only reporting gate.
Constipation transit-time references remain non-diagnostic; abdominal arrows are not massage instructions, persistent pain/vomiting/bloody stool prompts medical contact without waiting.
Edema and itch remain observations versus diagnoses, medication boundaries preserved; sleep complaints retain speaker/environment facts and individualized rest rather than blanket nap bans.

validation.scope: Own-locale AI semantic/editorial and structural checks; root handles runtime and remote persistence.

limits: Existing image-lettering limitations remain; no image modified.
Atomic own-locale week draft only; not whole-course or all-language completion.
